messages:
anika: Heads-up: I have a reproducible mem-growth pattern on long_ctx=32k with INT8 KV pages. After ~45m the process mem climbs steadily and latency P95 drifts.
sam: Repro steps? model/build/kv config please.
anika: Model: redwood/open-7b (int8-aware). Runtime: v0.9.3-canary. KV: page_size=48MB, eviction=deferred, compact_threshold=0.2. Batcher: max_tokens=4096, coalesce_ms=8. Repro script loops a 25k-token convo 300x.
kevin: Can you paste the minimal logs and any perf artifacts? :mag_right:
anika: Log excerpt:
```
[KV] pages_in_use=398 pages_free=1 frag_pct=28.9
[KV] page_id=212 state=dormant->rehydrate cost_us=4500 dequant_ms=3.9 memcpy_ms=1.2
[GC] compaction_time=21ms closed_holes=33
[RT] batch_size=2 avg_latency_ms=205 p95=312
```
liam: Two quick thoughts: (1) with INT8, footprint per key is smaller so we often never hit the compaction trigger; lots of small holes accumulate -> fragmentation. (2) rehydrate seems heavy because of dequant path + kernel selection may be wrong.
sam: Try: eviction=aggressive and kernel_hint=int8-accel-v2. Also collect batch size histogram.
anika: Ran the matrix this morning. 1h runs, mem delta / p95:
- deferred + generic-int8: +1.8GB / 310ms
- aggressive + generic-int8: +0.35GB / 224ms
- aggressive + int8-accel-v2: +0.42GB / 198ms
kevin: Weird: int8-accel-v2 is faster but mem slightly worse. Any accuracy diffs vs bf16?
anika: LAMBADA eval (1000 prompts): generic-int8: -0.8% vs bf16; int8-accel-v2: -1.3%.
kevin: That suggests quant/dq ordering differences. accel-v2 might fuse ops or use per-tensor scale that alters numeric error. I'll diff per-op outputs for a few tokens.
liam: Also observed: when compaction runs between batches, we see a short latency spike. That spike reduces batcher coalescing window (it thinks backlog grew) -> more small batches -> increased KV churn. Need batching histograms.
perf-bot: perf/job/1832203300 finished  kv-int8-longctx-thrash  P95=203ms mem_growth=+0.41GB artifacts: https://ci/redwood/jobs/1832203300/artifacts
anika: Proposed action items:
1) Telemetry: counters for page_rehydrate_count, per-kernel dequant_cost_us, frag_pct_gauge.
2) Short-term: set default eviction=aggressive when model.quant==int8 AND long_ctx>16k.
3) Kevin: per-op diff and quant impl audit for int8-accel-v2.
4) Liam: batching histograms in Console and a probe to see compaction timing vs batch window.
5) QA: run canary in Dedicated with A/B config and LAMBADA/HC evals.
sam: +1. Also add a small stress test for idle-hole-closing: simulate long idle windows and then heavy reuse to ensure rehydration amortization.
kevin: I'll start the per-op diffs and upload diffs+bit-exact traces. Expect results tomorrow.
liam: I'll try a prototype idle-time hole-closer that runs during low util windows and see if it reduces P95 variance.
anika: Filing INF-9901 with repro script + logs: https://go/internal/issue/INF-9901. Attaching flamegraph and minimal reproducer in the ticket.
sam: Good. Keep an eye on any accuracy thresholds we define for rollout. If accel-v2 regression >1%, hold for further tuning.
anika: Noted. Will keep thread updated. :white_check_mark:
